meta.title: R&D
meta.description: Sometimes, a product made with reference to market research data ends up being far different from what is expected. The Doll in front of you is an example of that.

units.rawText: Hehe, you've got a good eye. After all, back in the day, this questionnaire was the thing that resulted in the birth of a phenomenal livestreaming project, which is to say—

units.rawText: —The famous Project Streaming. Kuro, you've said it so many times that even the roomba over there knows it by heart now.

units.rawText: Looks like you still don't understand the historical significance of this questionnaire. In that case, allow me, Kuro, the super popular streamer, to personally explain it to you!

units.rawText: Yes, yes, this questionnaire was used to conduct market research for Project Streaming. You've told me this more than three times already.

units.rawText: It was used to conduct market research for Project Streaming; you've already told me at least three times, Kuro.
